title: Clea - Mistress of the Nevrons (Expedition 33)
description: Clea in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - who she is, the difference between the Clea fight at Flying Manor and Clea Unleashed in the Endless Tower, what each drops, and which ending outfit her defeat unlocks.
keyword: clea expedition 33, clea unleashed expedition 33, mistress expedition 33

facts.label: Drops
facts.value: Clea's Life (Pictos) · Clea's Death from Clea Unleashed

sections.title: Who Clea Is
sections.content: Clea is Verso's sister, which is why the Nevrons refer to her as Mistress - see the world lore page for how that family relationship fits the wider setting. She is fought rather than recruited, and her defeat is a checkpoint for both gear and one character's ending outfit.

sections.title: Where You Fight Her
sections.content:
There are two separate encounters, and they are easy to conflate:

  • Clea - Flying Manor. Beating her here is what drops Clea's Life.
  • Clea Unleashed - the Endless Tower version. This is the one that drops Clea's Death.

If you are looking for a specific Pictos, check which of the two it comes from before farming - the tower version sits behind a different gate than the manor fight.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Resistances
sections.content: Not confirmed for either encounter. Elemental affinities are listed on the enemy weaknesses and boss guide pages once they have been verified, rather than inferred from the fact that she is a Nevron-linked character.

sections.title: What Defeating Her Gives You
sections.content:
• Clea's Life - Pictos, from Clea at Flying Manor. Unlocks a Lumina after 4 battles.
  • Clea's Death - Pictos, from Clea Unleashed in the Endless Tower. Unlocks a Lumina after 4 battles.
  • Maelle's ending outfit - after defeating Clea, talk to the Young Boy in Central Plaza. Full list on outfits.

Best builds treats the Clea Unleashed drops as endgame pieces, so the tower fight is the one to prioritise once your party is built out.

sections.title: How to Approach the Fight
sections.content: The boss order guide's advice on Clea Unleashed applies to the enhanced form specifically: it is an encounter worth building for rather than walking into with a general-purpose party. Beyond that, no verified move list or parry pattern is recorded here yet.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content:
Every claim on this page is drawn from material already published elsewhere on this site - the Flying Manor and Endless Tower locations come from the Clea's Life and Clea's Death Pictos pages, the outfit from outfits, and the family relationship from world lore. Anything not stated there is left as not confirmed rather than filled in.
